_comment: TrueForge remote MCP connectors for Sentinel. Registered by scripts/setup-trueforge.sh, which replaces __MCP_AUTH_TOKEN__ with the token in .sentinel/mcp-auth-token. Servers are started by scripts/start-k8s-mcp.sh (https://github.com/Flux159/mcp-server-kubernetes over Streamable HTTP).

mcp_servers.name: k8s-sandbox
mcp_servers.description: Kubernetes tools scoped by RBAC to the sentinel-sandbox namespace only. Used for trial runs of a remediation.

mcp_servers.name: k8s-prod
mcp_servers.description: Kubernetes tools with full cluster access. Read tools run freely; every write tool is gated behind human approval by the Sentinel agent config.
